subject: Re: Kickoff: gradient-based hyperparameter tuning for the seq2seq stack
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing picture.

Staffing: Kaia 60%, Halima 40%, Rosa 50%, Csilla 40%. Enough for the 5/20 decision if the production-size comparison stays at one config.

Compute: the whole pitch is saving compute, so I am keeping the ask lean - 24 A100s best-effort on titan for the lt-en repro and the comparison run. The meta-gradient step roughly doubles per-step memory, so Halima may push us to 32 GPUs at the large config; I will flag if so.

Data dependency: the WMT-derived corpora come through Corpus, and we want to regenerate them with the new filtering once this window closes. Timing works out fine: the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07, so we can regenerate the WMT-derived corpora at the start of Q3 and still be comfortably ahead of it.

One env note: the reference code pins old jaxlib (cuda11 wheels) - Halima is containerizing so nobody installs that by hand.

Bruno
